meta.title: Role Evaluator
meta.subtitle: Score job descriptions against your priorities. Weighted across four dimensions: technical fit, environment, compensation, and learning trajectory.

knockouts.label: No AI/ML component in the role
knockouts.detail: Role is generic software engineering with no Gen AI, RAG, or ML work mentioned

knockouts.label: Primarily pre-training or research focus
knockouts.detail: Role is about training foundation models or academic research, not application engineering

knockouts.label: Large org with no clear AI product mandate
knockouts.detail: Signals Citi-style politics, slow pace, and disconnection from real impact

knockouts.label: Requires >3 years experience in a specific tool you don't have
knockouts.detail: Hard requirements (not preferred) in tools outside your stack with no adjacent experience

knockouts.label: Fully on-site outside London or requires relocation
knockouts.detail: Location constraints that don't work for you

items.question: Does the role explicitly mention RAG, vector search, or LLM application engineering?
items.signals: RAG, embeddings, vector DB, LangChain, semantic search, retrieval pipeline

items.question: Does the role involve agentic systems or workflow orchestration?
items.signals: LangGraph, agents, tool use, multi-step reasoning, autonomous workflows

items.question: Is the Azure / cloud stack aligned with your experience?
items.signals: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex — any major cloud AI platform

items.question: Does the role require Python as a primary language?
items.signals: Python listed first or prominently; ML/AI roles almost always require it

items.question: Is your data engineering or backend background directly relevant?
items.signals: pipeline design, data ingestion, Java/Spring, production systems, MLOps, backend APIs

items.question: Does the role involve evaluation, observability, or production quality of AI systems?
items.signals: RAGAS, evals, LangSmith, monitoring, quality metrics, A/B testing AI outputs

items.question: How well does the financial services domain knowledge translate?
items.signals: fintech, banking, financial data, compliance, capital markets, trading — or adjacent regulated industries

items.question: Does the company have a genuine AI product, not just an AI initiative?
items.signals: AI is core to revenue or product, not a side project or cost-cutting exercise

items.question: Does the role suggest proximity to real impact — shipping products, serving users?
items.signals: cross-functional teams, direct user feedback, product roadmap involvement — absence of "internal platform" language

items.question: Does the company size and stage suggest low politics and fast pace?
items.signals: scale-up 50–500 people, Series B/C, flat structure, startup culture — not a 50,000 person org

items.question: Is there evidence of engineering craft and technical rigour in how the role is written?
items.signals: specific technical requirements, system design mentioned, code quality culture, technical blog or open source presence

items.question: Does the role offer meaningful ownership and autonomy?
items.signals: lead, own, design, architect — not "contribute to" or "support the team in maintaining"

items.question: Does the company have a credible name that builds your CV for future moves?
items.signals: recognised in AI/tech/fintech circles in London; would make a founder or investor take notice

items.question: Is there any signal of supply chain, logistics, commerce, or operational domain exposure?
items.signals: inventory, distribution, fulfilment, procurement, B2B commerce — directly relevant to family business

items.question: Does the working arrangement suit you — hybrid or remote flexibility?
items.signals: London-based hybrid, 2–3 days in office — fully remote or fully on-site are both harder to sustain

items.question: What is the likely base salary range for this role and location?
items.signals: AI Engineer London: £70–90k mid, £90–130k senior, £130k+ staff/principal. Big tech adds 30–50% on top via equity/bonus

items.question: Is there meaningful equity or bonus on top of base?
items.signals: RSUs, EMI options, performance bonus, profit share — not just a token LTIP

items.question: Does the total compensation trajectory support meaningful savings rate within 2–3 years?
items.signals: clear seniority ladder, progression visible in JD, company stage suggests comp growth over time

items.question: Does the company's financial health and stage suggest stable employment for 2–3 years?
items.signals: funded, profitable, or large enough to weather a downturn — avoids early-stage burn risk

items.question: Will this role develop skills directly applicable to transforming the family business?
items.signals: AI for operations, demand forecasting, supply chain, customer analytics, B2B product thinking

items.question: Does the role expose you to the full AI product lifecycle — not just implementation?
items.signals: problem scoping, model selection, eval design, deployment, monitoring — end-to-end ownership builds founder instincts
